title: Ten years after the Sagamihara massacre, tributes and floral offerings take place at the Yamayuri Center
summary: Relatives, citizens and authorities remember the 19 victims of the attack on the disability center, in a day of reflection on inclusion and discrimination in Japan.

title: Yamamoto Yushin reaches 100 combined wins in Japan and the Major Leagues
summary: The Dodgers pitcher earns his eleventh win of the season and becomes the first Japanese player to reach the milestone in international professional baseball.

title: The Asuka-Fujiwara complex declared a UNESCO World Heritage Site
summary: The archaeological site containing the ruins of Japan's first imperial palaces becomes the 27th cultural property of Japan on the list.

title: Trump orders suspension of large-scale attack on Iran for fear of running out of anti-aircraft missiles
summary: The US president cancels the planned military operation after intelligence reports indicated a possible shortage of Iranian air defense missiles.

title: Torrential rains and thunderstorms cause flooding and blackouts in eastern and northern Japan
summary: Adverse weather conditions affect Niigata, Tohoku and Kanto, with flooded roads, lightning strikes and tornado warnings.

title: Sendai Matsudo loses the final and misses out on a ticket to the Summer Koshien along with other favorites
summary: The defeat against Takada Kobayashi in the Chiba final leaves the team out of the national tournament, and for the first time in 32 years none of the four spring semifinalists qualify.

title: 19-year-old golfer Kato Reina wins her first tournament on the Japanese professional circuit
summary: With an impressive score of 22 under par, the young woman wins the Daitoken Ladies Golf tournament and secures her first title.

title: Vehicle plows into crowd at LGBTQ festival in Germany: at least one dead and several injured
summary: Authorities investigate possible radical Islamist motive for the attack, which occurred in a German city during Pride celebrations.

title: Families of victims of Shin-Meishin expressway accident demand justice and road safety
summary: The tragic accident that killed six people on the Shin-Meishin expressway leads mourners to express their grief and demand preventive measures.

title: A father dies swept away by a rip current on the Ibaraki coast along with his two children
summary: Emergency services rescued the minors, unharmed, while the adult was found dead after being dragged by the current.

title: 'Day of the Ox' boosts consumption of grilled eel across Japan
summary: Restaurants and specialty shops experience a day of high customer traffic as people seek to combat the summer heat with the traditional dish, while experts explain the species of unagi.

title: Ansei Nishiki and Atami Fuji receive special awards on the final day of the Nagoya sumo tournament
summary: Wrestler Ansei Nishiki wins the Technique Prize and Atami Fuji the Fighting Spirit Prize on the final day of the summer tournament.

title: Sumo wrestler Oshomaru announces retirement from professional sumo at age 35
summary: Oshomaru, who competed in 19 tournaments in the top makuuchi division, expressed relief at the decision in a press conference.

title: Yokohama achieves its fourth consecutive qualification for the Summer Koshien, a record in Kanagawa
summary: The Kanagawa prefecture team becomes the first to string together four consecutive appearances in the national high school baseball tournament.

title: Hachioji Jissen earns its first ticket to the Summer Koshien after defeating Soka in the West Tokyo final
summary: The school's baseball team achieves the feat with a 1-0 victory, securing its first participation in the national tournament since the school was founded.

title: Nitta defeats Matsuyama Gakuin and returns to the Summer Koshien after five years
summary: The school from Ehime prefecture wins 12-3 in the prefectural final and secures its second appearance in the national tournament.
